# Aervyx workspace

- Use Electron, React, TypeScript, Vite, Monaco, and Fengari already defined in `package.json`.
- Keep Lua execution embedded and sandboxed. Do not add process injection, DLL injection, memory manipulation, anti-cheat bypass, or external client modification.
- Preserve `public/aervyx-logo.png` as the exact supplied Aervyx branding asset.
- Validate changes with `npm run build` after dependencies are installed.
